newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan lowers '97 estimate on 3 steel firms.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan lowers '97 estimate on 3 steel firms.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan steel analyst Mike Gambardella said he lowered his full-year '97 estimates for Allegheny Teledyne Inc, Lukens Inc, and J&L Specialty Steel Inc.
-- Allegheny was lowered to $1.70 from $1.85; Lukens was lowered to $0.50 from $0.85; and J&L was lowered to $0.40 from $0.60.

-- Gambardella said he lowered his estimates to reflect lower stainless steel prices in the beginning of 1997. He said U.S. prices bottomed out lower than expected, due to downward pressure from imports.

-- "During 1997, we believe U.S. stainless sheet prices will gradually improve, as the narrowing of the import/domestic price spread and the potential for trade cases against foreign mills reduces the availability of imports," he said.
